explanation: Sort Name entries by first name and then last name. Compact the list, retaining one representative for each first name. The supplied comparator checks first-name coverage rather than a particular representative.
timeComplexity: O(n log(n+1)) comparisons, plus name-character comparison costs
spaceComplexity: O(n) sort workspace and suffix copy
